answer.summary: A narrow research question is required to investigate explicit mechanisms for state continuity in non-sequential, burst-based input streams without relying on temporal structure or assumed memory coherence mechanisms.
answer.content: Search for arXiv preprints with abstracts or metadata containing explicit linguistic indicators of state continuity, memory persistence, or internal coherence in response to abrupt, non-temporal, burst-based stimuli. Focus only on linguistic evidence and avoid any inference beyond stated features in the text. Limit to one preprint per query to maintain focus and avoid redundancy.
